caveats: Mwimanzi v. Wilson, filed Jan 13, 2020 in U.S. District Court for D.C. by ACLU-DC for civilian Mbalaminwe Mwimanzi against MPD Officer Joshua Wilson over a sexually invasive Jan 2019 search. March 2022: court held D.C.'s warrantless-search law unconstitutional and let the invasive-search claim proceed. Per ACLU case page, defendants agreed to a monetary settlement in October 2022; amount not disclosed in any source, so settlement_amount_original is null. No source mentions criminal charges against Wilson either way, so criminal_status is unknown. WUSA9 fetch timed out; CourtListener docket returned 403.
